shortDescription: Wait for the fileserver VLDB registration

options.name: delay
options.description: Number of seconds to delay before waiting.

options.name: signal
options.description: If true, issue a XCPU signal to the fileserver to force it to resend the VLDB registration after C(sleep) seconds has expired. By default, the fileserver will retry the VLDB registration every 5 minutes untill the registration succeeds. This option can be used to force the retry to happen sooner. As a side-effect, XCPU signal will trigger a dump of the fileserver hosts and callback tables, so this option must be used with caution.

options.name: sleep
options.description: Number of seconds to wait between retries.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Maximum time to wait in seconds.
